---
title: "timeline"
format:
  html:
    fig-width: 12
    fig-height: 6
---

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)
library(here)

here::i_am("projects/timeline.qmd")
```


```{r}
timeline_df <- read_excel(here("data/timeline.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
```

```{r}
timeline_end <- as.Date("2029-06-01")

timeline_df %>%
  mutate(
    Category = str_trim(Category),
    Milestone = str_trim(Milestone),
    End_plot = if_else(
      is.na(End),
      as.Date(timeline_end),
      End
    ),
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c(
        "Coursework",
        "Funding",
        "Research",
        "Conferences",
        "Internship"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category, Start) %>%
  mutate(
    Milestone = factor(
      Milestone,
      levels = rev(Milestone)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category, Start) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Start,
    xend = End_plot,
    y = Milestone,
    yend = Milestone,
    color = Category
  )) +
  geom_segment(
    data = ~ subset(.x, Start != End_plot),
    linewidth = 1,
    lineend = "butt"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ subset(.x, Start == End),
    shape = 8,
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ subset(.x, Start != End_plot),
    aes(x = Start),
    shape = 8,
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ subset(.x, Start != End_plot),
    aes(x = End_plot),
    shape = 15,
    size = 4
  ) + 
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(as.Date("2024-01-01"), timeline_end),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b",
    sec.axis = dup_axis(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = as.Date(c(
        "2024-01-01",
        "2025-01-01",
        "2026-01-01",
        "2027-01-01",
        "2028-01-01",
        "2029-01-01"
      )),
      labels = c(
        "2024", "2025", "2026",
        "2027", "2028", "2029"
      )
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    )
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(as.Date(c(
      "2024-01-01",
      "2025-01-01",
      "2026-01-01",
      "2027-01-01",
      "2028-01-01",
      "2029-01-01"
    ))),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  )


```
